goal.objective: Materialize one exact provider-neutral LLM request from an already-admitted Personal-KV memory packet inside fenced resident bound state, without exposing private memory to repository state or minting admission/provider/write authority.
success_predicates: Resident-local context packet, memory-packet ALLOW artifact, and provider request input exist only in fenced bound state.
The existing LLM-adapter KV memory bridge validates exact packet/admission binding and emits one deterministic ProviderRequest hash.
The materialized ProviderRequest remains inside fenced bound state and contains no provider credential material.
The worker records no provider ingress, provider execution, provider egress, KV writeback, activation, or authority claim.
WorkerCoordinator fresh claim/fence semantics and ProcessWorkerAdapter mutation fencing remain authoritative.
failure_predicates: Private packet, prompt, or materialized ProviderRequest is written into GitHub repository state.
Repository source or CI is represented as authentic memory-packet admission or live model consumption.
The worker mints an InTr decision, TV/TVC provider operation, KV write, claim, fence, or model authority.
A hosted runner or second user-operated machine becomes the sovereign execution requirement.
Credential or token material appears in request input, bound-state output, evidence, or repository files.
authority_ceiling: resident-local Personal-KV memory packet to ProviderRequest materialization only

authority.authority_source: SV-KV-AI-PERSISTENCE-001 canonical task registry + existing WorkerCoordinator task-control boundary

completion.terminal_evidence: authentic same-execution memory-packet InTr ALLOW + provider ingress/TVC/response/egress evidence + KV writeback/readback evidence
terminal_when: authentic memory-packet InTr ALLOW is bound to the exact resident context packet
the exact ProviderRequest is materialized under a current WorkerCoordinator claim/fence
provider ingress, TV/TVC provider result where applicable, and provider egress are authentically observed
Master Records custody/reconstruction is retained for the same correlation
memory write proposal admission and exact target-KV readback are authentically observed
completion.next_authorized_action: When resident-local bound-state inputs exist, use the existing WorkerCoordinator to materialize the exact ProviderRequest; then continue only through already-existing external provider ingress/TVC/egress and target-KV admission paths.

activation.authorization_ref: SV-KV-AI-PERSISTENCE-001 canonical task registry + existing WorkerCoordinator
activation.claim_generation_rule: fresh WorkerCoordinator fencing generation; no historical claim/fence reuse
